summary.text: Patrick Hatlestad is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives representing District 1 (Williston), serving since 2007. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Education and Political Subdivisions.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Hatlestad is a retired, part-time teacher with a BA from Western Washington University and an MEd and EA from UND.

His biography lists past service as president of the Tri-County ED Board, the Williston Chamber of Commerce, Williston Rotary and the ND Elks Association, and board service with USND, Williams County Social Service and Northwest Human Services.
In the interim he serves on the Government Finance Committee and the Legislative Audit and Fiscal Review Committee.
His biography lists him as married to Durelle, with two children.
